## pickNiceLength() function

Rounds `target` to the nearest "nice" 1/2/5×10ⁿ value — for a legend that should read as a round number near some target size, such as the tree scale bar's branch-length I-beam. Distinct from [pickTickStep()](./core.picktickstep.md)<!-- -->, which picks the smallest nice step at or above a minimum.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function pickNiceLength(target: number): number;
```
